battle.name: 老撾內戰
battle.brief: 本場衝突是一九五三年十二月開始的老撾內戰，寮國王政府軍與受北越支援的寮國共產武裝在北部及中部山區對抗。列表所列裝備中，正式型號為 Steam ironclad 的蒸汽鐵甲艦於一八六五年服役，屬英國皇家海軍的遠洋主力艦種，配有蒸汽輪機與鐵甲防護，並非本場地面作戰實際使用的武器。

kit.name: 蒸汽鐵甲艦
kit.history: 蒸汽鐵甲艦在英國皇家海軍體系中屬裝甲主力艦，以蒸汽輪機推進、以鐵甲防護艦體，承擔艦隊作戰、護航與海外駐防，屬十九世紀中葉機械化海軍的重要艦種。

countries: 本篇所稱的「老撾內戰（1953）」，限定為第一次印度支那戰爭在老撾的年度戰役，不是1959年至1975年老撾內戰的完整歷史。交戰一方是法國遠征軍與法國聯盟部隊，包括外國步兵團、法屬北非及西非部隊，以及法屬印度支那部隊；與法國合作的有越南國軍、老撾王室、皇家陸軍與皇家警察。另一方是越南民主共和國的越盟人民軍，以及老撾革命黨（Pathet Lao，又稱巴特寮）。後兩者不是同一支軍隊，但共享邊境交通與游擊網，並在川擴戰區協調行動。地理重心是川擴省（Xieng Khouang）的萬年谷、北部山區與中部丘陵；維恩（Vieng）、豐沙灣（Phonsavan）、桑紐亞（Sam Neua）及富帕蒂山（Phou Pha Thi）的據點、機場與道路，構成法軍企圖維持的作戰骨架。
countriesEn: The Laotian Civil War of 1953 as used here means the 1953 Laos campaign of the First Indochina War, not the entire later civil-war period conventionally dated from 1959 to 1975. One side was the French Expeditionary Corps and French Union formations, including the Foreign Legion, French North and West African troops, and locally recruited Indochinese formations. The State of Vietnam, the Kingdom of Laos, the Royal Lao Army, and the Royal Lao Police operated with the French. The opposing side consisted of the Viet Minh forces of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam and the Pathet Lao, or Lao Revolutionary Party. The latter was a separate organization with its own armed forces and command structure, but it shared border routes and guerrilla networks with the Viet Minh and coordinated operations in Xieng Khouang. The geographical center was the Plain of Jars, the northern highlands, and the central hills of Xieng Khouang Province. Posts, airfields, and roads at Vieng, Phonsavan, Sam Neua, and Phou Pha Thi formed the framework that French forces sought to hold.
people: 1953年初的法軍最高指揮官是讓·德拉特爾·德·塔西尼；因健康惡化，他於4月底由亨利·納瓦爾接掌遠征軍。川擴前線的重要執行指揮則包括第2機動群（Groupe Mobile No. 2）指揮官查爾·塞雷克斯中校，以及比加爾上校所指揮的第3外國步兵團，這支部隊在北部山地、機場與富帕蒂山周邊反覆投入作戰。越盟方面，越南人民軍在武元吉的總指揮下，把1953年的西部戰役列為主要方向，以川擴的據點、道路和山間補給線牽制法軍；實際指揮各步兵團與迫擊砲分隊者另有其人。巴特寮由蘇富那旺領導，與越盟合作但保有自己的政治和軍事系統。老撾王國國王西薩旺·沃與首相蘇萬那·普馬則維持法國扶植下的政治秩序，並嘗試在兩種軍事力量之間保持有限自主。這些人物分屬政治領導、戰區指揮與技術參謀三個層次，並不是由一人統一指揮整場戰爭。
peopleEn: At the beginning of 1953, the overall French commander was Jean de Lattre de Tassigny. As his health deteriorated, he was succeeded late in April by General Henri Navarre. Important operational commanders in the Xieng Khouang front included Lieutenant-Colonel Charles Serex, commander of Mobile Group No. 2, and Colonel Marcel Bigeard, whose 3rd Foreign Infantry Regiment was repeatedly committed in the northern highlands, around airfields, and in the Phou Pha Thi area. On the Viet Minh side, the Vietnamese People's Army, under the overall direction of Võ Nguyên Giáp, made the western theater a principal focus of 1953. It sought to tie down French forces through bases, roads, and mountain supply routes in Xieng Khouang, while regimental and mortar detachments retained their own commanders. The Pathet Lao was led by Souphanouvong and remained a distinct political and military organization despite cooperating with the Viet Minh. King Sisavang Vong and Prime Minister Souvanna Phouma maintained the French-backed political order in Laos while seeking a limited degree of autonomy between the two armed sides. These figures occupied separate political, operational, and staff functions; no single individual directed the entire campaign.
kits: 1953年法軍戰區可以見到M1加蘭德步槍與供空降兵使用的M1卡賓槍，後者發射7.62×63毫米彈；MAS-38、MAS-44及1949年列裝的MAS-49步槍則使用7.5×54毫米彈。機槍包括Browning M2重機槍、M1919A4輕機槍、Hotchkiss Mle 1914、MAC 31與FM 24/29。法軍有60毫米及81毫米迫擊砲，並以75毫米Mle 1897山砲和105毫米Mle 1936榴彈砲形成營、團級火力。裝甲包括M3與M5A1史都華輕坦克及M8 Greyhound裝甲車，但離開道路後射界、迴轉空間和地雷都限制裝甲作用。C-47與C-54運輸機負責空投及遠距離後勤，Bell 47則用於聯絡、觀察與救援。越盟與巴特寮常見的武器包括莫辛－納甘91/30步槍、SKS、PPSh-41衝鋒槍、DP-27輕機槍、Maxim重機槍及繳獲的日製三八式步槍；主要彈藥包括7.92×54毫米及7.62×54毫米。越盟還使用82毫米迫擊砲、120毫米PM-38迫擊砲、繳獲的75毫米輕型野戰砲，以及GAZ-AA、GAZ-64卡車。法軍靠公路車隊與C-47空投維持補給，越盟和巴特寮則把步槍彈藥、迫擊砲彈與通訊器材分散到背負小組，並利用載重自行車及馱畜穿越法軍車輛難以通行的山徑。
kitsEn: French forces in the 1953 theater were armed with M1 Garand rifles and M1 carbines issued to airborne troops, the latter firing 7.62×63 mm ammunition. MAS-38, MAS-44, and the MAS-49 adopted in 1949 used 7.5×54 mm ammunition. Machine guns included the Browning M2 heavy machine gun, M1919A4 light machine gun, Hotchkiss Mle 1914, MAC 31, and FM 24/29. French units used 60 mm and 81 mm mortars, with battalion- and regimental fire support provided by 75 mm Mle 1897 mountain guns and 105 mm Mle 1936 howitzers. Armor consisted principally of M3 and M5A1 Stuart light tanks and M8 Greyhound armored cars, although mines, restricted visibility, and the limited turning space of forest tracks greatly reduced armored effectiveness away from roads. C-47 and C-54 transports carried supplies and parachuted them into isolated positions, while Bell 47 helicopters provided liaison, observation, and rescue work. Viet Minh and Pathet Lao units commonly carried Mosin-Nagant 91/30 rifles, SKS rifles, PPSh-41 submachine guns, DP-27 light machine guns, Maxim heavy machine guns, and captured Japanese Type 38 rifles. Their principal ammunition included 7.92×54 mm and 7.62×54 mm rounds. Viet Minh artillery included 82 mm mortars, 120 mm PM-38 mortars, captured 75 mm pack howitzers, and supply vehicles such as GAZ-AA and GAZ-64 trucks. French logistics depended on road convoys and C-47 air drops, whereas Viet Minh and Pathet Lao teams dispersed rifles, ammunition, mortar bombs, and communications equipment among pack groups, using bicycles and pack animals along routes unsuitable for French wheeled transport.
tactics: 法軍在1953年的作法不是深入控制全部山區，而是以公路、城鎮和機場維持縱深。1月的維恩戰役中，第2機動群沿萬年谷的主要道路推進，坦克與步兵互相掩護，空降部隊控制機場及側翼，75毫米與105毫米砲兵先準備火力，再由空軍反覆攻擊越盟陣地；越盟第6團一部利用土壘、樹線和後方陣地抵抗，使法軍必須逐個清除射界。奪回維恩後，法軍仍避免讓單一縱隊脫離補給深入追擊。進入春夏，法軍改守道路與孤立據點，遇襲時以營級機動群、砲兵和空援解圍；越盟則避開法軍正面推進路線，利用夜色接近據點，以小分隊襲擊哨所、糧秣庫和跑道，再用迫擊砲壓制機場與護送隊。富帕蒂山戰役最能顯示這種作法：第3外國步兵團、第1外國步兵空降營等單位依托山脊、陣地和著陸場構成防線，C-47分批空投槍彈與補給；越盟與巴特寮以分散步兵反覆衝擊，迫擊砲封鎖道路，並企圖消耗法軍炮兵與空降物資。雨季、濃霧和山谷地形則令空投偏移、地面補給遲滯，法軍最後依靠空軍掩護與後續部隊維持據點，而越盟也未能把包圍轉成對富帕蒂山的永久控制。
tacticsEn: French strategy in 1953 was not to occupy and control the entire mountain region, but to preserve depth through roads, towns, and airfields. In the Battle of Vieng, Mobile Group No. 2 advanced along the main road across the Plain of Jars. Tanks covered the infantry, airborne troops secured the airfield and flanks, and 75 mm and 105 mm artillery prepared the objective before French aircraft repeatedly attacked Viet Minh positions. A part of the Viet Minh 6th Regiment used earthworks, tree lines, and prepared positions to resist, forcing the French to clear each field of fire in turn. After retaking Vieng, the French avoided sending a single column beyond its supply route in pursuit. During the spring and summer, French troops guarded roads and isolated posts, responding to attacks with battalion-sized mobile groups, artillery, and air support. The Viet Minh avoided the main French axes of advance, approached posts at night, struck garrisons, supply dumps, and runways with small detachments, and used mortars to pin down airfields and escort columns. The Battle of Phou Pha Thi illustrates this pattern most clearly. Units including the 3rd Foreign Infantry Regiment and the 1st Foreign Parachute Battalion formed a perimeter around ridges, positions, and landing grounds, with C-47 transports delivering weapons and supplies in repeated drops. Viet Minh and Pathet Lao troops made repeated infantry attacks, used mortars to close the roads, and attempted to exhaust French artillery and airborne deliveries. The rainy season, fog, and mountainous terrain disrupted drops and delayed ground resupply. French ground forces ultimately maintained the post with air cover and relief troops, while the Viet Minh failed to turn the encirclement into permanent possession of Phou Pha Thi.
data: 戰役背景在1952年末已形成：越盟與巴特寮在川擴北部建立分散的游擊、觀察與後勤節點，法軍則控制萬年谷的主要道路和機場。1953年1月17日，法軍在維恩發動主要反攻，以第2機動群、裝甲、砲兵與空軍支援對付占據維恩的越盟部隊；法軍重新控制城鎮、機場及穿過萬年谷的交通線，但未將戰線深入越盟控制的山地。2月至3月，越盟與巴特寮轉而襲擊北部山區及道路沿線的小型據點，法軍有時增援，有時撤離難以維持的哨所，把兵力集中於可由公路或空運補給的節點。4月底，納瓦爾接掌法軍遠征軍，面對的是一個法軍能守住若干城鎮、卻難以控制廣大鄉村與山區的局面。5月至9月的雨季使道路泥濘、卡車速度下降，也增加空投與連絡的困難；越盟以小股步兵、迫擊砲和地方游擊隊持續施壓。10月13日至25日，戰役在富帕蒂山附近達到高潮，第3外國步兵團、第1空降營與其他聯軍部隊守住山間機場，越盟和巴特寮的包圍因法軍空運及地面反擊而未能奪取該據點。10月22日，老撾王國在戰鬥仍持續時正式宣布獨立，但法軍與法國行政機構仍留在境內，這使軍事控制與政治承認呈現分離。11月至12月，法軍保住豐沙灣、維恩及幾個關鍵機場，卻沒有能力摧毀越盟在山區的分散兵源與交通線；越盟也未占據法軍主要城鎮。雙方因此把部署帶入1954年，而1953年的年度戰役沒有形成一方迫使另一方投降或全面解除武裝的結果。
dataEn: The conditions for the campaign had formed by the end of 1952. Viet Minh and Pathet Lao units had established dispersed observation, guerrilla, and logistics nodes in northern Xieng Khouang, while the French held the main roads and airfields of the Plain of Jars. On 17 January 1953, the French launched their principal counterattack at Vieng, employing Mobile Group No. 2, armor, artillery, and air support against the Viet Minh force occupying the town. The French regained the town, airfield, and the transport line across the Plain of Jars, but did not carry the fight deeply into Viet Minh-held mountain territory. From February into March, Viet Minh and Pathet Lao forces turned toward small posts in the northern highlands and along the roads. The French reinforced some positions, evacuated others that were difficult to sustain, and concentrated on nodes reachable by road or airlift. Late in April, Navarre took command of the French expeditionary force and inherited a situation in which France could hold selected towns but could not control the wider countryside and mountains. From May through September, the rainy season turned roads to mud, reduced truck speed, and complicated airdrops and communications. Viet Minh infantry detachments, mortars, and local guerrilla networks maintained pressure. The campaign reached a climax around Phou Pha Thi from 13 to 25 October. The 3rd Foreign Infantry Regiment, the 1st Foreign Parachute Battalion, and other allied units held the mountain airfield against Viet Minh and Pathet Lao attempts to seize it; French airlift and ground relief prevented the encirclement from becoming a permanent loss. On 22 October, while the fighting continued, the Kingdom of Laos formally declared independence, although French troops and administrative institutions remained in the country. From November into December, the French retained Phonsavan, Vieng, and several key airfields but could not destroy the Viet Minh's dispersed recruiting areas and trail network in the mountains. The Viet Minh likewise failed to take the principal French-held towns. Both sides carried these deployments into 1954, and the 1953 campaign ended without either side compelling surrender or a general disarmament.
cause: 1953年老撾戰事的直接背景是1945年日本占領當地後法國權威崩解。越南民主共和國與寮國革命運動在戰後建立，越盟在越北集結力量，老撾革命黨則在老撾鄉村建立政治與武裝網絡。法國在1946年後重返印度支那，運用戰俘獲的日製武器重新裝備部隊，並在1950年扶植寮國國王西薩旺·沃與拉法那西哈尼查建立的親法政權；巴特寮則在1949年至1950年的內部鬥爭中由蘇富那旺一派取得主導地位。到1952年底與1953年，越盟已能把游擊、步兵團、迫擊砲和山區後勤結合，不再只是地方游擊隊。法軍無法接受川擴落入共產黨游擊網，因為維恩、豐沙灣與富帕蒂山一旦失去，通往越北及中部老撾的道路便會被切斷；越盟則需要這些山區作為西北方根據地，並以老撾戰區牽制法軍兵力。因此，1953年的衝突實際上同時是老撾政府與巴特寮爭奪鄉村控制、法國維持保護國和交通骨架，以及越盟在印度支那西部建立兵力與補給體系三者交疊的結果。地形和法軍人力限制，使雙方都依賴少數可防守節點，而無法迅速決定整個山區的歸屬。
causeEn: The immediate background to the fighting in Laos in 1953 was the collapse of French authority following the Japanese occupation of 1945. The Democratic Republic of Vietnam and the Lao revolutionary movement established themselves after the war. Viet Minh forces consolidated in northern Vietnam, while the Pathet Lao developed political and armed networks in the Lao countryside. France returned to Indochina after 1946, rearmed its troops with captured Japanese weapons, and in 1950 supported the monarchy of Sisavang Vong and the pro-French government of Souvanna Phouma. Within the Pathet Lao, the faction led by Souphanouvong gained control during the internal struggles of 1949 and 1950. By the end of 1952 and in 1953, the Viet Minh had combined guerrilla activity with infantry regiments, mortars, and mountain logistics; they were no longer operating only as local irregular bands. France could not accept the loss of Xieng Khouang to the communist guerrilla network, because the loss of Vieng, Phonsavan, and Phou Pha Thi would cut the roads linking northern Vietnam and central Laos. The Viet Minh, in turn, needed the highlands as a northwestern base area and as a means of tying down French strength. The 1953 conflict therefore combined three overlapping struggles: the Lao government and Pathet Lao competing for control of the countryside, France trying to preserve its protectorate and transport framework, and the Viet Minh building a military and logistical system in western Indochina. Terrain and French manpower limitations forced both sides to depend on a small number of defensible nodes, preventing either from quickly deciding control of the entire mountain region.
impact: 維恩與富帕蒂山兩次法軍戰術勝利，分別保住了萬年谷的道路與機場，以及通往越北山區的關鍵節點；它們延緩了越盟與巴特寮對法軍交通骨架的切割，卻沒有轉化為對山區游擊網的全面清剿。法軍由此更依賴空投、外來援軍和沿線據點，每次解圍都要求砲兵、空軍與機動步兵同時投入。越盟與巴特寮則顯示，地方游擊隊可掩護常規步兵團，使法軍即使奪回城鎮，也要持續面臨迫擊砲襲擊、據點滲透和道路封鎖。軍事僵局也提高了老撾政治問題的敏感性：10月宣布獨立使親法王室取得國家地位，卻未消除巴特寮的武裝控制與越盟的存在。這套據點防衛、補給分配和空運經驗，後來成為法軍在1954年西北戰區部署的重要背景。至於1953年老撾戰役的完整傷亡，現有法軍、越盟與老撾方面記錄並沒有一份經共同核對、涵蓋所有戰鬥的總表，因此只能確定若干據點曾被奪回或遭圍困，不能負責任地拼出一個精確傷亡數字。
impactEn: The two French tactical victories at Vieng and Phou Pha Thi preserved, respectively, the road and airfield across the Plain of Jars and a critical junction in the northern mountain routes. They delayed the cutting of the French transport framework by Viet Minh and Pathet Lao forces, but they did not become a general destruction of the mountain guerrilla network. French operations consequently became more dependent on airdrops, relief troops, and a chain of road-linked posts, with artillery, air support, and mobile infantry committed together whenever a position had to be relieved. The Viet Minh and Pathet Lao demonstrated that local guerrilla teams could shield conventional infantry, forcing the French to retain pressure through mortar attacks, infiltration, and road interdiction even after retaking a town. The military stalemate also sharpened the political question in Laos. The declaration of independence in October gave the French-backed monarchy national standing without removing the Pathet Lao's armed presence or the Viet Minh's position in the country. The experience of defending discrete nodes, allocating supply, and conducting airlifts later became an important background to French deployments in the northwestern theater in 1954. No surviving French, Viet Minh, and Lao records provide a single reconciled total covering every engagement of the 1953 campaign. The defensible conclusion is limited to which posts and airfields changed control; assembling an exact casualty total from separate battlefield reports would create false precision.
result: 截至1953年12月，結果是法軍與老撾王室保住主要城市、萬年谷道路和數個關鍵機場，越盟與巴特寮則保有廣大山區的游擊基地、地方兵源與分散補給線。維恩和富帕蒂山應記作法軍的戰術勝利，但老撾年度戰役在戰略上仍是混合結果：法軍未能把短期據點控制擴展為對鄉村與山區的永久控制，越盟和巴特寮也未能奪取豐沙灣、維恩等主要城鎮或迫使法軍投降。這不是後來老撾內戰的終局，也不代表第一次印度支那戰爭已於1953年結束；它只是雙方在更密集衝突前形成的臨時格局。老撾於10月22日取得形式上的獨立，卻仍保留法國的軍事存在。評估本戰役時，不應以口號或未經核實的總傷亡取代具體結果；可以確認的是道路、機場和山區控制權仍然分割，而這種分割把法軍、越盟與巴特寮直接帶入1954年的下一階段部署。
resultEn: By December 1953, the French and the Royal Lao government retained the principal towns, the main roads of the Plain of Jars, and several key airfields. The Viet Minh and Pathet Lao still controlled extensive mountain bases, local recruitment networks, and dispersed supply routes. Vieng and Phou Pha Thi must be recorded as French tactical victories, but the outcome of the 1953 Laos campaign was strategically mixed. France could not convert temporary possession of particular posts into permanent control of the countryside and mountains, while the Viet Minh and Pathet Lao could not take the major towns of Phonsavan and Vieng or compel the French to surrender. This was not the conclusion of the later Laotian civil war, nor did it mean that the First Indochina War had ended in 1953. It was an interim alignment that carried both sides directly into the more intensive deployments of 1954. Laos obtained formal independence on 22 October while the French military presence continued. The campaign should therefore be assessed through the control of roads, airfields, and mountain positions rather than slogans or an unverified casualty total. The durable result was a divided pattern of control that remained unstable and carried the French, Viet Minh, and Pathet Lao into the following year's operations.
